module_summary: dash_card_tool.c is the dashboard's memory-card image tool: it opens .mcd/.ps2/.bin images through a 4-way 4 KB block cache (ctRead/ctWrite) into mc_card_view/mc_card_write, and implements Card contents (copy, move, delete, export, import), resize to a new card, split into MMCE Game ID cards, new blank card, multi-file convert and import, an All saves view over every image in a folder, a .psu Save library with named sets, and the MMCE active-card/switch dialogs. Every write makes a verified safety copy (WLE-Safety/, newest 10 kept) and reads the result back. dash_card_tool.h exports those entry points plus two helpers used by dash_ps1_card.c. dash_clock_sync.c sets the PS2 RTC from SNTP (0.pool.ntp.org over the ps2ips RPC sockets) or from a manual date/time, converting between Unix time, JST RTC base and BCD and verifying by read-back.

reusable_helpers.name: ctRead
reusable_helpers.what: McViewSource read callback over an open file with a 4-way 4 KB block cache

reusable_helpers.name: ctWriteFileAs
reusable_helpers.what: writes a buffer to a file (optionally O_EXCL), reads it back and removes it when it differs

reusable_helpers.name: dashCardWriteVerified
reusable_helpers.what: exported O_EXCL write-and-verify of a buffer

reusable_helpers.name: ctSafetyCopyOf
reusable_helpers.what: numbered verified safety copy of a card image in WLE-Safety/, pruning to the newest 10

reusable_helpers.name: ctLoadPsu
reusable_helpers.what: reads a whole save file (.psu or any mc_save_formats format) into McSaveData

reusable_helpers.name: ctStamp
reusable_helpers.what: console RTC as an 8-byte memory-card timestamp

reusable_helpers.name: civilDays / civilFromDays
reusable_helpers.what: days since 1970 from Y/M/D and back (Hinnant algorithm)

reusable_helpers.name: toBcd / fromBcd
reusable_helpers.what: BCD byte encode/decode for sceCdCLOCK fields

reusable_helpers.name: dashClockDaysInMonth
reusable_helpers.what: days in a month with leap-year rule; exported

findings.title: Cached card-image reader ctRead/ctOpen is a copy of mmce_backup.c fp_read/card_fingerprint
findings.problem: ctRead (45 lines) and mmce_backup.c fp_read (44 lines) are the same 4-way, 4 KB block cache line for line, differing only in names (CardIo/FpReader, CT_WAYS/MMCE_FP_WAYS, ct_cache/fp_cache); the struct and the open sequence (tags to -1, genOpen, size via lseek, fill McViewSource, mcViewOpen) are also repeated in ctOpen and card_fingerprint. Each copy keeps its own 16 KB static cache.
findings.fix: Keep one reader (struct, read callback, open/close) in one file and export it; have card_fingerprint call it with read-only access. Delete the other copy and its defines.
findings.justification: Replaces a duplicated 45-line cache plus open sequence with one shared copy; the export is a single declaration, so the net change is a removal.
findings.benefit: ~55 lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges). Sharing the 16 KB cache as well would save 16 KB .bss (4*4096, INFERRED), but only if no fingerprint runs while a card-tool image is open; not verified.
findings.evidence: Read dash_card_tool.c:35-145 and mmce_backup.c:31-42,204-278. Grep McViewSource/src.read over src: only dash_card_tool.c:121/136, mmce_backup.c:255/269, mmce_save_versions.c:114/126 (the last is an uncached reader). Body of ctRead and fp_read compared line by line: identical apart from identifiers.

findings.title: ctLibToCard re-implements dashCardImportMany (port < 0) for library .psu files
findings.problem: ctLibToCard picks a card image, runs ctStacks/ctWritable, confirms, then loops ctLoadPsu + ctPutSave with one shared safety copy, counts done/skipped/failed/left, and builds the same summary text (2518-2533 matches 1917-1932) as dashCardImportMany does for a dir plus names[]. dashCardImportMany also refuses PS1 and read-only PCSX2 images up front, which ctLibToCard does not.
findings.fix: Build a names[] array of the picked lib->list[i].rel strings and call dashCardImportMany(lib->folder, names, n, -1); delete ctLibToCard's body. If the set name in the confirm title matters, pass it as an optional title argument.
findings.benefit: ~55 lines removed (71-line function replaced by ~15 lines building names[]; INFERRED). One import path to test instead of two.
findings.evidence: Read both functions in full. ctLibToCard callers: ctLibApplySet 2681, ctLibFileMenu 2708, dashCardSaveLibrary 2813. dashCardImportMany callers: dash_browser.c:1072, 3057. lib->folder ends in '/' (2727-2728) as dashCardImportMany requires. Skip sets differ slightly: lib counts MCW_ERR_INVALID as skipped (2511), ImportMany maps unreadable saves to MCW_ERR_UNSUPPORTED (1899), same outcome.

findings.title: Format-new-image, copy-saves and verify-list sequence written three times (ctResize, ctGameCard, dashCardNewBlank)
findings.problem: ctResize 1069-1107 and ctGameCard 1152-1191 both: genOpen O_EXCL, mcCardFormat via ctAppend, close, then per save ctReadSave + ctOpen rw + mcCardWriteSave + ctClose, then reopen and require mcViewListSaves to count exactly the copied saves. dashCardNewBlank repeats the open/format/close part. The source prelude (ctOpen, mcCardReadIdentity, mcViewListSaves, refuse more than 250 saves with the same text, copy names) is also duplicated between ctResize 998-1028 and ctSplitGameId 1227-1251.
findings.fix: Let ctResize call ctGameCard with a NULL id meaning every save (ctGameCard already takes the list and filters by id), and have dashCardNewBlank call the same format step with n = 0; merge the two source preludes into one helper that returns the identity and the name list.
findings.benefit: ~40 lines removed (INFERRED from the repeated ranges).
findings.evidence: Read 985-1128, 1144-1291, 1401-1506. The two save loops (1079-1096, 1159-1176) and the two list checks (1097-1107, 1177-1191) differ only in the id filter and the extra game-id check; refusal text at 1013 and 1239 is the same sentence.

findings.title: mmce_igr.c write_verified duplicates ctWriteFileAs
findings.problem: write_verified (41 lines) writes a buffer with O_TRUNC, reads it back in chunks, compares and removes the file on mismatch; ctWriteFileAs does exactly this (with fresh=0) and is already exported in its O_EXCL form as dashCardWriteVerified.
findings.fix: Give dashCardWriteVerified the fresh flag (or export ctWriteFileAs) and call it from mmce_igr.c; delete write_verified.
findings.benefit: ~38 lines removed (INFERRED). No RAM change: mmce_igr's 32 KB verify_buf is still used by inspect_helper_path (mmce_igr.c:248-256).
findings.evidence: Read mmce_igr.c:170-230 and dash_card_tool.c:549-593. Grep for write-and-verify helpers in src: only dashCardWriteVerified and mmce_igr.c write_verified (callers 318, 413, 418, 449). Grep verify_buf: lines 32, 205-207, 248-256.

findings.title: dash_clock_sync.c keeps two copies of BCD, day-count and RTC write/verify code
findings.problem: manualToBcd/manualFromBcd (377-385) are byte-identical to toBcd/fromBcd (251-259), which sit inside #ifdef ETH; manualSerialSeconds (401-412, loop over years) recomputes what civilDays does; dashClockSetManual's set/write/read-back/decode/compare (438-474) repeats writePs2Clock + clockLocalSeconds (282-312, 261-280).
findings.fix: Move toBcd, fromBcd, civilDays and clockLocalSeconds above the #ifdef ETH, delete the manual* copies and manualSerialSeconds, and verify the manual write by comparing clockLocalSeconds(&check) with the seconds of the raw_* RTC values (one shared write-and-verify helper for both paths). Update tests/test_clock_field_editor.py, which extracts manualLeap, only if it is touched.
findings.benefit: ~30 lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges); static functions, so a few hundred bytes of .text at most.
findings.evidence: Read the whole file. ETH is defined for the wLaunchELF target (ps2.yaml:624), so both copies are compiled. Callers of dashClockSetManual/dashClockSyncInternet: dash_settings.c:3529, 3540. tests/test_clock_sync.py extracts source from '#define SNTP_PACKET_SIZE' to the '#else'; test_clock_field_editor.py extracts manualLeap.

findings.title: ps2ips RPC socket shim (externs, hostent/sockaddr views, htons) declared in both dash_clock_sync.c and cloud_http.c
findings.problem: The seven ps2ipc_* extern prototypes, the SntpHostEnt/CloudHostEnt and SntpSockaddrIn/CloudSockaddrIn structs and sntpHtons/cloud_htons are the same declarations under different names; cloud_http.c additionally declares ps2ipc_ioctl and ps2ipc_getpeername.
findings.fix: Put the shared prototypes, the two structs and the byte swap in one small header (or in cloud_http.h) and include it from both files; delete the private copies.
findings.justification: A new header of ~25 lines replaces ~55 duplicated lines in two files; the copies must otherwise be kept in step with the PS2IP RPC ABI by hand.
findings.benefit: ~25 lines removed net (INFERRED: 28 + 35 duplicated lines minus a ~28-line header); no binary change.
findings.evidence: Grep 'extern .*ps2ipc_(socket|gethostbyname|recv|select)|sin_zero\[8\]|static u16 \w*htons' over the repo: only dash_clock_sync.c and cloud_http.c. No header in include/ or ee_libs/tcpips/ declares ps2ipc_*. tests/test_clock_sync.py uses the names SntpHostEnt and SntpSockaddrIn from the extracted source, so the test needs the header included or the names kept.

findings.title: BCD-to-int helper defined in six EE source files
findings.problem: fromBcd, ctBcd, dashBcdToInt, bcdToInt (twice) and bcd_to_int are the same one-line function for decoding sceCdCLOCK fields, each followed by the same six-field decode of the RTC.
findings.fix: Declare one static inline bcd decoder in a shared header (main_title.h, which already owns RTC conversion) and delete the six copies.
findings.benefit: ~20 lines removed (6 copies of 4 lines minus one 3-line inline; INFERRED); no binary change expected.
findings.evidence: Grep '>> 4\) \* 10|>> 4\) & 15\) \* 10' over src: exactly the six cited definitions (plus manualFromBcd in dash_clock_sync.c:382, covered by finding 5). The IOP copies (iop/ps2hdd_osd, iop/vmcman btoi) are separate binaries and are not included.

findings.title: Days-in-month table and leap-year rule implemented three times
findings.problem: dashClockDaysInMonth is exported (dash_internal.h:1128) yet filer_actions.c has isCustomDateLeapYear/getCustomDateDaysInMonth and main_title.c has daysInMonth with the same table and rule.
findings.fix: Call dashClockDaysInMonth from filer_actions.c and main_title.c and delete their copies (main_title's 31 for an invalid month needs its callers checked; they pass a normalized month).
findings.benefit: ~20 lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges).
findings.evidence: Grep '(Leap|leap|DaysInMonth|daysInMonth|days_in_month)\w*\s*\(' over the repo: definitions only at dash_clock_sync.c:387,392, filer_actions.c:457,462, main_title.c:81. Read all three bodies. main_title.c callers at 105,137,189,234 not traced for out-of-range months (INFERRED safe).

findings.title: Small repeated idioms inside dash_card_tool.c
findings.problem: File stem without extension is cut three times (275-280, 1043-1048, 1275-1280); a trailing '/' is appended to a folder three times (1433-1440, 2187-2194, 2723-2728); the -N free-name loop twice (1050-1055, 1443-1450); the size list is declared twice (987 is the first 7 entries of 1403); the read-only string twice (1511, 1579); the icon.sys-title-or-folder-name choice three times; and ctSplitGameId copies a string literal into msg[160] only to pass it on (1369).
findings.fix: Add two static helpers (stem of a name, folder with trailing slash), use one sizes[] table with a count, one read-only string, one title helper, and pass the literal at 1369 directly (dropping msg from ctSplitGameId).
findings.justification: Each helper replaces three in-file copies, so the file gets shorter.
findings.benefit: ~30 lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges); static code, small .text change.
findings.evidence: Read every cited range. msg in ctSplitGameId: declared 1219, used only at 1369-1370 (awk over 1214-1371). No shared stem/trailing-slash helper in include/ (Grep '(Slash|slash)\w*\s*\(' over include: none).

findings.title: ctBaseName is a copy of dash_ps1_card.c p1Base
findings.problem: Both return the path component after the last '/' or ':' with identical bodies; dash_card_tool.h is already the header shared between the two files.
findings.fix: Export one of them through dash_card_tool.h and delete the other.
findings.evidence: Grep "strrchr\(\w+, ':'\)" over src shows the two identical static functions; dash_main.c:1029-1031 and others inline the same idea. dash_ps1_card.c includes dash_card_tool.h (it calls dashCardSafetyCopyBuffer at 151 and dashCardWriteVerified at 365).

findings.title: McViewSave.title_break is written in two places and never read; icon.sys header parse duplicated
findings.problem: title_break is set by ctPsuInfo (2320, 2323-2324) and by mc_card_view.c (311, 314-315); no production code reads it, only the host test print at tests/mc_card_view_host.c:44. ctPsuInfo's icon.sys check and title copy repeat mc_card_view.c's.
findings.fix: Delete the title_break field and the lines that set it (and its print in the host test); optionally let ctPsuInfo call one shared icon.sys header parser from mc_card_view.c.
findings.benefit: ~7 lines removed, 2 bytes per McViewSave (ct_saves holds 250, plus the 1000-entry All saves list; INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep title_break over all .c/.h/.py: mc_card_view.h:56, mc_card_view.c:311,314,315, dash_card_tool.c:2320,2323,2324, tests/mc_card_view_host.c:44 (printf only). Grep '"PS2D"' over src: dash_card_tool.c:2318, mc_card_view.c:309, filer_copy.c:661, makeicon.c:386.

findings.title: Single-caller forwarding wrappers ctSafetyCopy and ctWriteFile
findings.problem: ctSafetyCopy only calls ctSafetyCopyOf(image, NULL, 0, ...) and has one caller (384); ctWriteFile only calls ctWriteFileAs(..., 0) and has two callers (642, 2599).
findings.fix: Delete both wrappers and call ctSafetyCopyOf/ctWriteFileAs directly at the three call sites.
findings.benefit: ~10 lines removed (two 4-line functions and their blank lines; INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep 'ctSafetyCopy(|ctWriteFile(' over src and include: ctSafetyCopy only at 338 (definition) and 384; ctWriteFile at 585 (definition), 642, 2599.

findings.title: Stale file banner and a misplaced function comment in dash_card_tool.c
findings.problem: The banner says the file handles single-save copy/move/delete/export/import for .mcd/.ps2/.bin, but it also holds resize, Game ID split, blank cards, convert, All saves, the Save library and the MMCE switch dialogs. Lines 1935-1938 describe ctAllBatch (defined at 2008) but sit directly above ctAllExport's own comment.
findings.fix: Shorten the banner to name the file's scope, and move the 1935-1938 comment to ctAllBatch (merging it with 2006-2007).
findings.evidence: Read the whole file. The lead for lines 9-12 (code-like comment) is a numbered list of write steps, not commented-out code, so it was dropped.

findings.title: Non-ETH stub of dashClockSyncInternet is compiled by no build
findings.problem: ETH is always defined for the only EE target (ps2.yaml:624) and the DS34 variant does not remove it, so the #else stub is unreachable.
findings.fix: Delete the #ifdef ETH / #else stub / #endif, or leave it only if the project decides to keep ETH optional across its ~30 guarded files. tests/test_clock_sync.py cuts the source at '\n#else' and must get a new end marker.
findings.evidence: ps2.yaml:614-630 defines ETH; grep ETH in scripts/configure_ds34.py: no match (no removal). grep -rlw ETH src include: 30 files use the macro, so this is a repo-wide choice. tests/test_clock_sync.py:10 uses source.index('\n#else').
